import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the datasets
adjusted_savings_df = pd.read_csv('/data/Adjusted_savings_education_expenditure_percentage_of_GNI.csv')
exports_df = pd.read_csv('/data/Exports_of_goods_and_services_annual_percentage_growth.csv')
gni_per_capita_df = pd.read_csv('/data/GNI_per_capita_constant_2015_USdollar.csv')

# Melt the datasets to long format for easier analysis
adjusted_savings_df_melted = adjusted_savings_df.melt(id_vars=['Country Group', 'Country Code'], var_name='Year', value_name='Education_Expenditure')
gni_per_capita_df_melted = gni_per_capita_df.melt(id_vars=['Country Group', 'Country Code'], var_name='Year', value_name='GNI_per_capita')
exports_df_melted = exports_df.melt(id_vars=['Country Group', 'Country Code'], var_name='Year', value_name='Exports_Growth')

# Merge the datasets on 'Country Group', 'Country Code', and 'Year'
merged_df = pd.merge(adjusted_savings_df_melted, gni_per_capita_df_melted, on=['Country Group', 'Country Code', 'Year'])
merged_df = pd.merge(merged_df, exports_df_melted, on=['Country Group', 'Country Code', 'Year'])

# Drop rows with missing values
merged_df = merged_df.dropna()

# Calculate the correlation between Education_Expenditure and GNI_per_capita
correlation_education_gni = merged_df['Education_Expenditure'].corr(merged_df['GNI_per_capita'])

# Calculate the correlation between Education_Expenditure and Exports_Growth
correlation_education_exports = merged_df['Education_Expenditure'].corr(merged_df['Exports_Growth'])

# Calculate the correlation between GNI_per_capita and Exports_Growth
correlation_gni_exports = merged_df['GNI_per_capita'].corr(merged_df['Exports_Growth'])

correlation_education_gni, correlation_education_exports, correlation_gni_exports

from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression

# Prepare the data for regression
X_education_gni = merged_df[['Education_Expenditure']]
y_gni = merged_df['GNI_per_capita']

X_education_exports = merged_df[['Education_Expenditure']]
y_exports = merged_df['Exports_Growth']

# Create linear regression models
model_education_gni = LinearRegression()
model_education_gni.fit(X_education_gni, y_gni)

model_education_exports = LinearRegression()
model_education_exports.fit(X_education_exports, y_exports)

# Get the coefficients
coefficient_education_gni = model_education_gni.coef_[0]
coefficient_education_exports = model_education_exports.coef_[0]

coefficient_education_gni, coefficient_education_exports

import statsmodels.api as sm

# Prepare the data for regression with intercept
X_education_gni = sm.add_constant(merged_df[['Education_Expenditure']])
y_gni = merged_df['GNI_per_capita']

X_education_exports = sm.add_constant(merged_df[['Education_Expenditure']])
y_exports = merged_df['Exports_Growth']

# Create linear regression models
model_education_gni = sm.OLS(y_gni, X_education_gni).fit()
model_education_exports = sm.OLS(y_exports, X_education_exports).fit()

# Get the p-values
p_value_education_gni = model_education_gni.pvalues[1]
p_value_education_exports = model_education_exports.pvalues[1]

p_value_education_gni, p_value_education_exports
